components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--glow, #63D2E8); background: var(--glow-soft, rgba(99,210,232,0.16)); color: var(--glow, #63D2E8); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6.5px 14px; font: 500 12.5px/1.4 var(--sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--glow, #63D2E8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 360px; padding: 20px 20px 16px; background: var(--panel, #0C1424); border: 1px solid var(--line, #1E2E4A); border-radius: 4px; transition: transform 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1), border-color 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1), box-shadow 350ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--glow, #63D2E8); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -14px rgba(4,7,13,0.45); } .ds-card-meta { font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--dim, #92A8C9); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 500 22px/1.2 var(--serif, 'Cormorant Garamond', serif); color: var(--text, #EBF0F8); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--dim, #92A8C9); }

components.name: StarMap Node
components.description: Signature constellation node: a star with halo, ring and serif label that lights cyan on hover/focus.
components.css: .ds-star { background: var(--ink, #070B14); } .ds-star-edge { stroke: var(--glow, #63D2E8); stroke-width: 0.9; opacity: 0.26; transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-star:hover .ds-star-edge { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-star-halo { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-star-ring { fill: none; stroke: var(--glow, #63D2E8); stroke-width: 0.8; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-star-dot { fill: var(--text, #EBF0F8); transition: fill 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1), r 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-star-lbl { font: 500 21px var(--serif, 'Cormorant Garamond', serif); fill: var(--text, #EBF0F8); transition: fill 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.24,1); } .ds-star-sub { font: 400 11.5px var(--sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.08em; fill: var(--dim, #92A8C9); } .ds-star-node:hover .ds-star-halo, .ds-star-node:focus-visible .ds-star-halo { opacity: 0.22; } .ds-star-node:hover .ds-star-ring { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-star-node:focus-visible .ds-star-ring { opacity: 0.9; stroke-width: 1.4; } .ds-star-node:hover .ds-star-dot, .ds-star-node:focus-visible .ds-star-dot { fill: var(--glow, #63D2E8); r: 7; } .ds-star-node:hover .ds-star-lbl, .ds-star-node:focus-visible .ds-star-lbl { fill: var(--glow, #63D2E8); } .ds-star-node:focus { outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a watch kept through the night: a dark, still field of sky, a star chart drawn with an instrument-maker's care, and a campfire that answers when you lean toward it. Nothing shouts. The quiet is the point, and inside that quiet the details are alive. Stars twinkle on their own phase, meteors fall in evenly-spaced places so no pattern repeats, and the flame sways with the pointer and grows when stoked. The warmth is in the hand-made physics, not in the palette.

Density is low and deliberate. Surfaces are near-black navy in two tiers (page and raised panel), bounded by hairline 1px lines and a faint chart grid. A single cool accent, Starlight Cyan, marks everything interactive; a single warm accent, Campfire Ember, is held back for fire and for failure. Serif display type (Cormorant Garamond, with Noto Serif SC for Chinese) gives headings a literary, hand-lettered voice; Plus Jakarta Sans keeps body and controls plain and readable.

Motion is one grammar everywhere: one easing curve, short hover transitions, and a slower "scene" transition between pages that feels like moving from one place to another rather than loading a new screen. Every ambient animation respects reduced motion and the site's own motion toggle, and drops to a single still frame when asked.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, bilingual (zh/en), with a full light theme driven by the same tokens.
One cool accent (Starlight Cyan) for interaction, one warm accent (Campfire Ember) held in reserve.
Flat at rest; shadow appears only as a response to state.
Hairline 1px borders and a 4px corner as the near-universal form.
Signature canvas/SVG worlds (StarMap, SkyCanvas, Campfire) carry the personality; the chrome around them stays restrained.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Starlight Cyan means "this responds to you." Never use it for decoration, static headings, or illustration fills that aren't interactive.

rules.name: The Ember in Reserve Rule
rules.body: Campfire Ember is not a second brand color. It appears for fire, for code literals, and for failure states. Never as a button, link, or general highlight.

rules.name: The Token Flip Rule
rules.body: Themes switch by flipping CSS custom properties under [data-theme="light"]. Components consume tokens and never branch per theme; only canvas code and non-color assets (gradients, shadows) carry explicit light overrides.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Works Rule
rules.body: Serif is for names and titles only. Controls, labels, metadata, and body copy are always sans.

rules.name: The Shadow-Is-State Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a resting shadow. If something casts a shadow, it is hovered, focused, or floating above the page.

dos: Do use Starlight Cyan (glow) for every interactive state and nothing else.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and add the Hover lift (0 12px 28px -14px rgba(4,7,13,0.45) with translateY(-2px)) only on hover/focus.
Do use 4px corners and 1px Hairline borders as the default form for new cards, controls, and inputs.
Do use the shared easing cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.24, 1): about 300ms for hover states, 760ms for scene transitions.
Do add new theme-dependent color as a token flipped under [data-theme="light"], not as per-component theme branches.
Do give every ambient animation a still state that honors prefers-reduced-motion and the site's motion toggle.
Do set names and titles in the serif and everything operable in the sans.
donts: Don't use Campfire Ember (ember) for buttons, links, or general highlights.
Don't add resting shadows to cards or panels.
Don't use solid filled accent buttons; the primary action is a haze fill with a cyan outline.
Don't introduce a second cool accent or a gradient brand color.
Don't use Tailwind dark: variants for theming; consume the flipping tokens instead.
Don't set controls, labels, or body copy in the serif.
